standard_prerequisites.name: Closed points exist in every nonempty decent subset

standard_prerequisites.name: Finite residue field degree over decent points
standard_prerequisites.use: Boundedness of the degrees of closed points.

core_obligations: Work on the reduced closed subspace Z of |X|; the local dimension function u -> dim_x is bounded.
Closed points of Z exist and lie over closed points of X; the dimension at a closed point is finite and attained.
The supremum is attained at a closed point with maximal degree; the infimum argument is dual using a minimal closed point.
proof_roadmap: Reduction to reduced closed subspace; closed points exist; attainment.
difficulty_reason: A dimension bookkeeping argument; the attainment at closed points is the substance.
